name: KuaiRec
description: A fully observed recommendation dataset based on user-video interaction data from the Kuaishou short-video platform, designed to support evaluation of recommender systems and studies of exposure bias. This record is loader-only and does not distribute dataset files.
citation: Gao, C., Li, S., Zhang, Y., Chen, J., Li, B., Lei, X., and Jiang, P. (2022). KuaiRec: A Fully-observed Dataset and Insights for Evaluating Recommender Systems. Proceedings of the 31st ACM International Conference on Information & Knowledge Management (CIKM 2022). https://doi.org/10.1145/3511808.3557624
